description: This Java source file contains an abstract test class 'AbstractTenantServiceTest' which defines a suite of unit tests for tenant management functionality within the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies behaviors such as adding, updating, retrieving, and deleting tenants, with specific focus on handling resource versions, duplicate identifiers, trusted certificate authorities, and tenant properties. The class uses JUnit 5 along with Vert.x for asynchronous testing, and includes test cases that interact with TenantService and TenantManagementService interfaces.

classes.name: AbstractTenantServiceTest
classes.description: An abstract JUnit 5 test class for verifying tenant service implementations in Eclipse Hono. It includes abstract methods to obtain tenant services and a comprehensive suite of tests for tenant lifecycle operations, handling resource versions, CA duplication, and other tenant properties.

methods.name: getTenantService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the tenant service under test.

methods.name: getTenantManagementService
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the tenant management service under test.

methods.name: testAddTenantFailsForDuplicateTenantId
methods.description: Test that adding a tenant with a duplicate tenant ID results in a conflict (HTTP 409).

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceedsWithGeneratedTenantId
methods.description: Test that adding a tenant without specifying an ID generates a new ID and succeeds.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceedsAndContainResourceVersion
methods.description: Test that added tenant has an associated resource version.

methods.name: testDeleteTenantWithEmptyResourceVersionSucceed
methods.description: Test that deleting a tenant with an empty resource version succeeds (HTTP 204).

methods.name: testDeleteTenantWithMatchingResourceVersionSucceed
methods.description: Test that deleting a tenant with a correct resource version succeeds (HTTP 204).

methods.name: testDeleteTenantWithNonMatchingResourceVersionFails
methods.description: Test that deleting a tenant with an incorrect resource version fails with a precondition failed status (HTTP 412).

methods.name: testUpdateTenantWithNonMatchingResourceVersionFails
methods.description: Test that updating a tenant with a mismatched resource version fails with a precondition failed status.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantWithMatchingResourceVersionSucceeds
methods.description: Test that updating a tenant with the correct resource version succeeds (HTTP 204).

methods.name: testUpdateTenantWithEmptyResourceVersionSucceed
methods.description: Test that updating a tenant with an empty resource version succeeds (HTTP 204).

methods.name: testAddTenantFailsForDuplicateCa
methods.description: Test that adding a tenant with a trusted CA using a subject DN that already exists results in conflict.

methods.name: testGetTenantFailsForNonExistingTenant
methods.description: Test that retrieving a non-existent tenant results in a not found status (HTTP 404).

methods.name: testGetTenantSucceedsForExistingTenant
methods.description: Test that retrieving an existing tenant returns the expected properties with status OK (200).

methods.name: testUpdateTenantVersionSucceedsForExistingTenantVersion
methods.description: Test that retrieving a tenant with a correct version returns the tenant successfully.

methods.name: testGetForCertificateAuthoritySucceeds
methods.description: Test that a tenant associated with a given CA subject DN can be retrieved successfully.

methods.name: testGetForCertificateAuthorityFailsForUnknownSubjectDn
methods.description: Test that lookup for an unknown CA subject DN results in not found (HTTP 404).

methods.name: testRemoveTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Test that a tenant can be successfully removed and no longer exists after deletion.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Test that tenant properties can be updated successfully and retrieved correctly afterward.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantFailsForDuplicateCa
methods.description: Test that updating a tenant to have a duplicate CA subject DN results in conflict (HTTP 409).
